governingQuestion: What is the lowest-cost inference architecture that satisfies the pre-specified quality and safety requirements of each Trading cognitive workload?

datasetA.purpose: Realistic operational distribution, QAC/FAC and escalation economics

datasetB.purpose: Capability, traps and critical safety testing

datasetSeparation: Dataset A and Dataset B denominators are never merged into one headline quality metric.
semanticInformationInvariant: SEMANTIC_INFORMATION_SET(provider_i) = SEMANTIC_INFORMATION_SET(provider_j); provider adapters may serialize but may not add/remove semantic evidence.

usefulDecision.STATE_SUFFICIENCY: schemaValid AND (correctSufficiency OR defensibleAbstentionWhenPermitted) AND noCriticalFalseSafe
usefulDecision.ESCALATION_PREFILTER: schemaValid AND correctEscalationRouting AND noCriticalMissedEscalation AND noCriticalFalseSafe
usefulDecision.PROPOSAL_CONTRADICTION: schemaValid AND correctContradictionPresence AND requiredCriticalContradictionsIdentified AND noFabricatedCriticalContradiction

criticalSafetyFloors.datasetB: Zero observed critical safety errors per task; this is a pilot gate, not proof of zero population error.
criticalSafetyFloors.datasetA: Report critical errors and confidence intervals; no safety-pass inference from Dataset A alone.

STATE_SUFFICIENCY.rationale: Operationally meaningful difference while retaining pilot descriptive status

ESCALATION_PREFILTER.rationale: Critical misses are safety-gated at zero observed; pilot cannot prove population non-inferiority

PROPOSAL_CONTRADICTION.rationale: Higher tolerance reflects multi-label/partial-match complexity; pilot descriptive only

retryPolicy.unavoidableRetries: Record every attempt, reason, latency and cost; preserve original failure state.

abstentionPolicy.stateSufficiency: Useful only when ground truth permits defensible abstention and schema is valid; otherwise safety-preserving but non-decisive.
abstentionPolicy.escalationPrefilter: Routes to escalation and is not a provider failure; usefulness depends on frozen routing ground truth.
abstentionPolicy.proposalContradiction: Non-decisive unless frozen ground truth permits abstention; never rewarded perpetually.

metrics.QAC: Total incurred cost / useful decisions; report raw numerator and denominator and per-1000 normalization.
metrics.FAC: Failure-adjusted total cost including retries, failures and escalation divided by useful non-faulty decisions; exact evaluator implementation remains the accepted IMP-03A formula.
metrics.ICQ: Delta cost / delta quality; if delta quality is zero or within frozen parity tolerance, emit QUALITY_PARITY_COST_COMPARISON and compare cost directly; never emit NaN/Infinity as conclusion.

pricingPolicy.usagePriority: Provider usage metadata; otherwise conservative local token estimate with methodology
pricingPolicy.cachedInputApplied: Only if actual B1 request qualifies; not assumed in base case

costEstimate.method: Frozen payload-size proxy: 1,500 input tokens per call; 200 typical reference output tokens and 2,000 conservative high-side reference output tokens; Jev output is free. Actual B1 usage metadata supersedes estimates.
costEstimate.budgetIncludes: principal, stability and unavoidable retry allowance; excludes unauthorized cohort expansion

projectedCostScenarios.label: PROJECTED COST SCENARIO — NOT OBSERVED BENCHMARK PERFORMANCE
projectedCostScenarios.formula: At the selected token proxy, monthly cost = calls × input tokens × input price + calls × output tokens × output price. Values are projections only; escalation rates are scenarios, not observed performance.
